_note: IMP-22 additive development corpus. The IMP-20 reader spec and evidence remain untouched. Ten qualification-holdout bases and two calibration-only bases each produce an unmodified clean control, an explicit schema-valid reader-visible blocker, and an explicit non-blocking craft weakness. Labels are curator-authored development fixtures, not independent-human or literal owner-authored judgments.

governance.noInCampaignInstrumentTreadmill: If a material instrument defect is found after qualification starts, terminate that role experiment ID and repair offline once; never relabel or replace a live holdout case.
